name: Soyuz-1
about: Soyuz-1 (1967-037A), a crewed vehicle (7K-OK), launched 1967 Apr 23. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (D).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1967 Apr 23), held fixed
